name: Voxel-Space Ambient Occlusion
definition: A multiresolution screen-space voxel based ambient occlusion technique that improves G-buffer based techniques by avoiding artifacts such as haloing, scalable to the level-of-detail desired by the user.
summary: Voxel-Space Ambient Occlusion is a multiresolution screen-space technique that computes ambient occlusion using a coarse voxel representation to avoid haloing artifacts and allow user-defined level-of-detail.
